description: Source code for generating and manipulating on-disk JFFS2 filesystem structures for MTD devices, including functions for creating directories, files, parsing existing data, and writing data to MTD partitions.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Pads the buffer to align with the erase size, erasing and writing blocks as needed.

methods.name: add_dirent
methods.description: Adds a directory entry with specified name, type, and parent inode.

methods.name: add_dir
methods.description: Creates a directory inode and associated directory entry.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds a file and its data to the filesystem structure.

methods.name: mtd_replace_jffs2
methods.description: Replaces or adds JFFS2 filesystem data on an MTD device.

methods.name: mtd_parse_jffs2data
methods.description: Parses existing JFFS2 data to identify directory structure and inode numbers.

methods.name: mtd_write_jffs2
methods.description: Writes a file into a JFFS2 filesystem on an MTD device, creating necessary directory structures.
